modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ayame_pap: Highly configurable PaperDoll mod. Unofficial fork of Ayame PaperDoll (by HappyRespawnanchor), itself a fork of Extra Player Renderer.
fml.menu.mods.info.description.ayame_pap: Highly configurable PaperDoll mod. Unofficial fork of Ayame PaperDoll (by HappyRespawnanchor), itself a fork of Extra Player Renderer.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.display_pr:
Priority for drawing the PaperDoll above other HUD elements or screens.

§eDefault§r: Use the original HUD layer.
§eHigh§r: Draw above chat, subtitles, and persistent in-game UI. Inventory and ESC still cover it.
§eHighest§r: Draw above most in-game screens, except the ESC pause menu.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.visual_con:
Adjust the PaperDoll's appearance through a visual interface.

§eLeft Click§r: Adjust the PaperDoll's position.
§eShift + Left Click§r: Adjust the name tag position.
§eRight Click§r: Adjust X/Y rotation. In Lock mode, this edits the lock-mode rotation.
§eCtrl + Right Click§r: Adjust Z rotation.
§eMouse Wheel§r: Adjust the PaperDoll's size.
Visual Configuration Editor is only available in-game.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.lock_rotat: X rotation used only when Rotation Mode is Lock. You can adjust it by right-dragging vertically in the visual editor while Lock mode is selected.
Y rotation used only when Rotation Mode is Lock. You can adjust it by right-dragging horizontally in the visual editor while Lock mode is selected.
Z rotation used only when Rotation Mode is Lock. You can adjust it with Ctrl + right-drag in the visual editor while Lock mode is selected.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.rotation_m:
Adjust the PaperDoll rotation/action sync mode.

§eUnlock§r: Follow player facing while using rotation limits.
§eLock§r: Keep the player facing forward while using rotation limits.
§eFully Sync Player Motion§r: Fully sync head, body, and pitch motion, ignoring rotation page limits.
§eHalf Sync Player Motion§r: Sync player motion, but straighten the body when it turns more than 45 degrees away from the screen.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.pitch.desc: Determines the vertical offset of head rotation in degrees.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.pitch_rang: Determines the number of degrees the head can rotate up or down.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.head_yaw.d: Determines the horizontal offset of head rotation in degrees.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.head_yaw_r: Determines the number of degrees the head can rotate left or right.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.body_yaw.d: Determines the horizontal offset of body rotation in degrees.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.body_yaw_r: Determines the number of degrees the body can rotate left or right.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.pose_offse:
Method of offsetting player's position when the player changes its pose.

§eAuto§r: Adjust height according to the height of entity's eyes.
§eManual§r: Manually set the offset when sneaking, swimming, using elytra and crawling.
§eForce Standing§r: Only renders in standing pose.
§eDisabled§r: No offset.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.sneak_offs:
Y offset when player is sneaking.

Works only when §aPosture Offset Method§r is set to §eManual§r.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.swim_crawl:
Y offset when player is swimming or crawling.

Works only when §aPosture Offset Method§r is set to §eManual§r.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.elytra_off:
Y offset when player is flying using an elytra.

Works only when §aPosture Offset Method§r is set to §eManual§r.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.hurt_flash: If rendered model turns red when player takes damage.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.swing_hand: If the rendered hands swing when trying to break blocks.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.render_ent: Render entity-bound effects such as fire, invisibility, hurt overlays, and equipment enchantment glint when available from vanilla entity rendering.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.render_eff: Render potion swirls and the burst from a Totem of Undying on the PaperDoll.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.effect_par: Multiplier for potion swirl particle density on the PaperDoll.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.max_refres: Maximum number of PaperDoll texture updates per second. Use 0 for unlimited refresh rate.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.light_degr: The degree of light source producing shadow effects.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.use_world_: If use the light level in the world to render.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.world_ligh: Minimum brightness when useWorldLight is enabled.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.display_na: Whether to display player name and scoreboard labels on the PaperDoll.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.name_tag_m: Mirror the name tag independently from the PaperDoll model. Turn this off to keep text readable when the model is mirrored.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.name_tag_s: Scale multiplier for PaperDoll name tags. 0 makes the text size hidden.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.name_tag_o: Horizontal fine tuning for the PaperDoll name tag. You can also hold Shift and drag with left click in the visual configuration editor.
Vertical fine tuning for the PaperDoll name tag. You can also hold Shift and drag with left click in the visual configuration editor.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.pause_game: Whether to pause the game when the configuration screen is open. (effective in single-player only)
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.disable_co: Controls whether the background blur effect is displayed on the in-game configuration screen.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.visible_du: Whether to display only during sprinting, jumping, flying, sitting, swimming, crawling, or flying with elytra.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.hide_on_sc: Hide when a screen (e.g., game menu or inventory) is open.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.spectator_:
Automatically switch entity model in spectator mode.

Overrides §2Player Name§r option if enabled.
config.ayame_paperdoll.option.player_nam: The name of the player to render. It will be your name when left blank.
